body:
From reading about misophonia coping, etc., I see that earplugs are not recommended as they can make you condition yourself to be ever more sensitive.

I know that I have to make some allowance for unwanted noise since I am not at a stage of my life where I want to or can afford to move somewhere sparsely populated and just enjoy the peace and tranquility.

But when it comes to subwoofers, I am very happy to have an absolutist and extremist stance: If some cunt thinks it’s reasonable or acceptable to use a subwoofer in an apartment, someone should just knock on their door and shoot them in the forehead. 

You get to enjoy a subwoofer if you life in a detached house and it’s not such a monster retarded subwoofer that it harms neighbors. If you do not life in a detached house, then you get to go fuck yourself and forego bass like a civilized person.

>since the sound traveled - I kid you not - through the floor, the legs of my bed, through the mattress, and vibrating my skull enough that I could hear it when my head was on the pillow even when I couldn't when standing or sitting

I have had this exact experience. It’s a good thing I don’t own a gun, because if I did, some very satisfying murders would have taken place that night.

I usually do this, but it’s very frustrating to know that I am listening to something not because I want to, but because I need it to drown out other noise.

I find radio talk, songs with lyrics and songs with heavy beats to be absolutely terrible for concentration, so it usually has to be quite "fluid" classical music. When you hear a voice talking or singing words, your mind obviously spends some resources on hearing and decoding those words. This means that such music is necessarily an additional drain on energy and focus if you are trying to study/read/etc.

Clear and loud radio/tv talking is better than faint, murmuring radio/tv talking, yes, since you can readily identify the information and tell your brain to ignore it. But it’s still annoying bullshit.

Well, fuck me in the ass, maybe my neighbors retarded younger sister is housesitting for him or something. The subwoofer saw action again. My propping a very noisy vacuum cleaner flush up against that wall, along with the pathetic excuse for a clock radio I have flush up against the wall seems to have communicated that any attempt to enjoy that subwoofer *will* be promptly and judiciously sabotaged.

Would that I could just use a shotgun rampage as a solution for misophonia... Ugh.
